scripts.check: npm run build:deps && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run structure && npm run knip && npm run dup && npm run test && node scripts/quality/pre-push.mjs --stamp
scripts.build:deps: npm run build -w @interlock/protocol -w @interlock/highlight && npm run build -w @interlock/client
scripts.dev:app: npm run build:deps && npm run dev --workspace @interlock/app
scripts.dev:daemon: npm run build:deps && npm run dev --workspace @interlock/server
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:deps && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" npm run dev --workspace @interlock/desktop
scripts.build:desktop: npm run bundle:daemon --workspace @interlock/desktop && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" npm run build --workspace @interlock/desktop
